series.title: The collectors' palette
series.note: Twelve colours for the Strip Paintings, one nudge each. Each nudge after the first offers only colours standing clear of everything already locked, so the palette balances itself as it fills.

rule: A nudge steers. It never commands. The studio may act with, against, or without the result.
